Container.Name: WARNO-Dedicated-Server
Container.Overview:
WARNO dedicated server using the official Eugen Systems Docker image.
Before starting the container, create these files in /mnt/user/appdata/warno/settings:
1. login.ini 2. variables.ini 3. params_for_ai.json
You must request a dedicated server login/API key from Eugen Systems.
Router forwarding required: Forward BOTH TCP and UDP for your chosen EXPOSEDPORT to your Unraid server.
Container.Requires: Requires a Eugen Systems WARNO dedicated server login/API key. Requires config files in /mnt/user/appdata/warno/settings.

Config.Name: WARNO Settings Folder
Config.Description: Folder containing login.ini, variables.ini, and params_for_ai.json

Config.Name: Public WAN IP
Config.Description: Your public Internet/WAN IP address that WARNO clients will connect to.

Config.Name: WARNO Server Port
Config.Description: Public server port. Forward this port as both TCP and UDP to your Unraid server.
